_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is NOT tracked (the repo .gitignore blanket-ignores *.json); this example is the tracked reference for the schema. Keys prefixed _comment are ignored by server.py.
_comment_host: 127.0.0.1 = local only, and the only safe default: anyone who can reach the API can run containers on this host. 0.0.0.0 exposes it to the whole network - read README.md 'Security' first. If this key is absent server.py falls back to 0.0.0.0.
_comment_token: Non-empty => every /api call must carry ?token=<value> or an X-Token header. The bundled UI does not forward it, so a token currently means API-only use. See README.md 'Security'.
_comment_gpu_lease: OPTIONAL and omitted here, which is the normal case: GPU profiles then run as plain `docker compose`. The keys gpu_lease and gpu_status name an external card-arbiter binary and its status command, for a box where several people or agents contend for the same cards. No such tool ships with this project. A bare name is looked up on PATH, an absolute path is used as-is; both are resolved once at startup with shutil.which(), and an unresolvable name is treated as absent.
_comment_hf_home: Absolute path to the HuggingFace cache the model picker lists from. No ~ or $VAR expansion is done. Delete the key to fall back to $HF_HOME. A path that does not exist just means an empty model list.
_comment_custom_dir: Where YAML created in the UI is written. Optional; defaults to control-panel/custom/.
_comment_repos: One entry per compose stack. dir = the cwd every `docker compose` call runs in, so the stack's relative volume mounts resolve; compose = the file parsed for `profiles:`. Absolute paths are recommended - relative ones resolve against the panel's working directory.
_comment_profile_defaults: Env-var defaults the panel applies to services it launches, keyed by <repo>::<profile>. Pre-filled and editable in the UI, and enforced server-side at launch so a bare /api/up is identical to a UI launch. An explicit non-empty value wins; an empty string is inert at launch and only pre-fills the control. Pin only things that are a property of THIS BOX (TP/DP/EP, concurrency, host-specific MINISGL_* knobs) - see README.md 'Leave the per-model knobs empty'.
_comment_profile_controls: Knobs promoted out of the generic env-var list into real UI controls, keyed by <repo>::<profile>. type is select (needs options), number or text; label is the caption, placeholder the hint shown when the field is empty. Anything not listed here still appears in the overridable env list.
